verdict.rationale: Shopify ships a scriptable CLI (shopify-docs-3, shopify-docs-17, shopify-docs-30, shopify-docs-42) and GraphQL Admin/Storefront APIs (shopify-docs-18, shopify-docs-31) plus dev-store environments (shopify-docs-x2) that could be driven non-interactively, and the CLI's single-command install suggests scriptability. However there is no explicit documentation of running the CLI or admin API headlessly in a CI/CD pipeline (e.g., GitHub Actions integration, non-interactive auth flags), so the automation story is only inferable, not directly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs, non-interactive/headless auth flow for CLI, example pipeline configs.
